title: Pinned: the upload Save's old-erase refusal at the store, on its own
evidence: Done 2026-11-26 (US-16 AC5), tests only: widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store-upload-save.test.ts "US-16 AC5 (H109)". Since R5 the Save carries its erase (WebSaving.erase) and the store's check is storage/upload-save-store.ts saveUploadThrough's first refuses; the session's edit refusal is the second. The new case bypasses the session's edit refusal (edit called with the current erase) and a Save pressed before an erase is still refused before any original is written, the record unchanged. Bites: the store's first refuses removed fails it (expected ok: false, got ok: true) while the file's 13 other cases, the AC2a ones included, still pass. The session layer is pinned on its own by widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts (the edit refusal in record-session.ts removed fails its setLpaUnit, markReportEmailCaptured and setReminderOptIn cases).
